mapper.sql: o.id, o.org_code, o.org_name, o.org_type, o.parent_id, o.ancestors, o.org_level, o.org_path, o.legal_person, o.contact_person, o.contact_phone, o.contact_mobile, o.province, o.city, o.district, o.address, o.business_license, o.tax_no, o.org_status, o.auth_status, o.status, o.tenant_id, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark, p.org_name AS parent_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_organization c WHERE c.del_flag = 0 AND c.parent_id = o.id) AS child_count, (SELECT t.tenant_name FROM agri_md_tenant t WHERE CAST(t.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = o.tenant_id LIMIT 1) AS tenant_name
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM agri_md_organization o LEFT JOIN agri_md_organization p ON p.id = o.parent_id AND p.del_flag = 0 WHERE o.del_flag = 0
AND o.tenant_id = CONVERT(#{tenantId} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ORDER BY o.org_level ASC, o.org_path ASC, o.id ASC

SELECT * FROM agri_md_organization WHERE del_flag = 0
AND tenant_id = CONVERT(#{tenantId} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ORDER BY org_level ASC, org_path ASC, id ASC

SELECT FROM agri_md_organization o LEFT JOIN agri_md_organization p ON p.id = o.parent_id AND p.del_flag = 0
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT FROM agri_md_organization o LEFT JOIN agri_md_organization p ON p.id = o.parent_id AND p.del_flag = 0 WHERE o.del_flag = 0 AND o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id, o.org_code, o.org_name, o.org_type, o.legal_person, o.contact_mobile, o.business_license, o.auth_status, o.create_time, o.tenant_id, t.tenant_name AS tenantName FROM agri_md_organization o LEFT JOIN agri_md_tenant t ON CAST(t.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = o.tenant_id
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
